overview: You tried a spring note, struck it, and stopped. The owl was not written. The last line was still open. You left both for tomorrow, before dinner.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the line, struck it, and left the desk.

important_dates.meaning: A line, and then a stop
